statement: A town's transit office wants to estimate the percent of the town's adult residents who would use a new evening bus route. Which of the following survey methods is most likely to produce results that represent all adult residents of the town?

choices.text: Survey every adult who boards a bus at the town's main bus station on one Monday morning.
choices.misconception: I thought people at the bus station know the most about buses, but current riders are much more likely to say yes than the town's adults overall.

choices.text: Post the survey on the transit office's website and use every response that is submitted.
choices.misconception: I thought more responses would make the results better, but people who choose to answer an online survey about buses may care more about buses than other residents do.

choices.text: Survey the members of a neighborhood group that has asked the town for more evening buses.
choices.misconception: I picked a group that knows the topic well, but a group that already asked for evening buses would give a much higher percent than the whole town.

choices.text: Randomly select $300$ adults from a list of all the town's adult residents and survey them.

hints: Who has a chance of being chosen under each method?
A sample represents a population when every member of the population has the same chance of being chosen and people do not pick themselves.
Only one method chooses at random from a list that includes every adult resident of the town.

solutions.reliable: To represent all adult residents, the sample must be chosen at random from all adult residents. Surveying riders at the bus station, collecting volunteer responses online and asking a group that already wants evening buses all favor people who are more interested in buses than the typical resident, so those methods would likely overstate support. Randomly selecting $300$ adults from a list of all adult residents gives every resident the same chance to be chosen, so it is the method most likely to represent the town.

author: Devansh Sanghavi
